name: spa-request-capture-and-block
description: Capture the exact outbound request body a single-page app sends and block it before it leaves the browser: patch window.fetch AND XMLHttpRequest together (the XHR half is the one usually missed, so a fetch-only wrapper lets the request through), read the parsed payload off window, and disarm with a reload — including why a hash-route change does not remove the patch. For actions whose side effect costs credits or creates an irreversible record.
author: voitta-ai
